name: Punishing: Gray Raven
description:
About This Game

Punishing: Gray Raven is a Fast-paced Sci-fi Action RPG.

Humanity stands on the brink of extinction. Earth has been overrun by the Corrupted—a mechanical army twisted and warped by the deadly biomechanical virus known as The Punishing. The last remnants of mankind have taken refuge in orbit aboard the spacefaring vessel Babylonia. After years of preparation, the Gray Raven, an elite task force, now leads the mission to reclaim their lost homeworld. You are their Commandant.

As the commandant of the Gray Raven squad, you must assemble the most powerful Construct soldiers ever created and lead them into battle. Uncover the dark truths behind the Punishing Virus, push back the Corrupted, and reclaim Earth in this stylish, high-octane action RPG.

LIGHTNING-FAST COMBAT

Immerse yourself in fluid, high-speed combat with real-time 3D control. Seamlessly switch between squad members mid-fight, master unique abilities, and chain together dazzling combos. Utilize an intuitive 3-Ping skill system to parry, dodge, and unleash devastating Signature Moves.

A DYSTOPIAN SCI-FI SAGA

Delve into a beautifully ruined world and unravel the mysteries of a grim cyberpunk future. Through rich visual-novel storytelling spanning hundreds of chapters, discover a hauntingly beautiful universe filled with hidden wonders—and even darker secrets waiting to be uncovered.

EXPLORE A FALLEN PLANET

Journey through breathtaking environments—from desolate city ruins and desert battlegrounds to towering megastructures and surreal digital realms. Battle the Corrupted across frozen wastelands and beyond Earth's atmosphere in an ever-expanding cinematic narrative.

STYLIZED POST-HUMAN AESTHETIC

Flesh is no match for the Punishing Virus. Mankind's last hope lies in the Constructs—human consciousness housed in advanced mechanical bodies. Recruit and command a diverse roster of these living weapons, each meticulously designed and animated in full 3D, to face off against hundreds of enemy variants.

SYMPHONY OF DESTRUCTION

Move to the pulse of an electrifying soundtrack that blends atmospheric synthscapes with intense drum & bass. Every battle becomes a rhythmic dance of destruction—a feast for both the eyes and ears.

A SANCTUARY BEYOND THE FIGHT

Find respite from the relentless war in the warmth of the character dormitory. Customize your space with various themes, interact with beloved characters, and cherish the moments of peace you're fighting to protect.
